title: The Quiet Vow
author: Edmund Ravensworth
blurb: Kestrel Galloway, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
